occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The last Children's Products Certification form 2885 was completed on 3/8/23.    NOTE:  The provider was asked to fill out a current form during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records- Training Hours: The primary caregiver and two assistant caregivers did not have training records showing completion of training for Emergency Preparedness, Food Allergies, Building Grounds & Safety, Handling Hazardous Materials and Administering Medication for the evaluation period of 12/2024-11/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §747.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: A family member did not have an orientation completed on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: An 11 month old was observed sleeping in a play yard and the sheets were not tight fitting.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Four out of twelve child files evaluated did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: A background check for a family member who turned 14 years old in March was not entered into the system until 7 months later.

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two children were observed in the living room during nap time while a caregiver was watching television.
